title: Sleave
summary: SLEAVE, noun The knotted or entangled part of silk or thread; silk or thread untwisted. SLEAVE, verb transitive To separate threads; or to divide a collection of threads; to sley; a word used by weave

inlines.v: SLEAVE, noun The knotted or entangled part of silk or thread; silk or thread untwisted. SLEAVE, verb transitive To separate threads; or to divide a collection of threads; to sley; a word used by weavers.
